text:
maria: quick flag: we've had a few asks for ephemeral delegated SA tokens that can be minted by projects. proposal: default delegated tokens to project-attributed, but allow org-scoped delegation for cross-project operators. need routing, quota attribution, and console UX decisions.

sam: ok. what does "project-attributed" mean for billing and quotas? if a token is minted by service X in proj-A and used against proj-B resources, which project pays/consumes quota?

maria: proposal A: charge the minting project (creator). Proposal B: charge the effective target project. both have tradeoffs. creator-charged is simpler for abuse control; target-charged matches resource ownership.

irene: telemetry required either way. we should add `auth.creator_project`, `auth.target_project`, and `auth.effective_project` to logs, and a boolean `auth.delegated` so dashboards can filter. Also emit `auth.token_lifetime` for ephemeral keys.

leo: console UX: in delegation modal show both fields: "Issued by: project-X" and "Attribution: [creator | target | split]" with a tooltip explaining billing impact. default selection should be conservative (creator) and require org-admin override for target attribution.

sam: quota enforcement: if we charge creator, we might see surprising spikes in some projects when a cross-project operator runs a batch job. we should implement soft-quotas with alerting and a hard deny only when thresholds are exceeded for 5m. also surface per-token usage in the keys table.

maria: agreed on soft quota first. for migration path, offer an "attribute to target" opt-in per token with a simulated 30d backtest of quota effect (same idea as project-default keys). irene, can you add a metric that computes "billing_delta_if_target_attr"?

irene: yes. I'll add a derived metric `auth.billing_delta_candidate{token}` and a tag for `candidate_reason=delegation_high_cohesion` when >90% of usages map to a single target project for 7d.

leo: rollout: behind feature flag. initial canary limited to internal tooling orgs + a couple of customers. Need audit logs with full `creator_project`/`target_project` in papertrail.

sam: routing algorithm question: when both creator_project and hint header present, precedence? I'd say explicit header (X-Redwood-Project-Hint) should win for routing but we should still record creator_project for billing decisions.

maria: agree. add a diagnostic event `auth.delegation_routed_by_hint` when hint overrides defaults. also mark any requests routed differently than token metadata for investigation.

irene: dashboards I'll mock: panel 1 `delegated token usage by effective_project`, panel 2 `tokens with high cross-project fanout`, panel 3 `billing delta simulation`. will post mocks.

sam: add prometheus alert `AuthDelegation:HighCrossProjectFanout` when a token's cross-project ratio exceeds 40% across >1h. that will catch suspicious shared tokens.

maria: security note: ephemeral tokens must have a short TTL default (1h) and must be revocable via console API. add revoke button in token detail with audit modal.

leo: SDKs should include helpers to request tokens with `X-Redwood-Project-Hint` and `X-Redwood-Skip-Attribution` (for org-admins only). sample: ```
POST /v1/tokens
Authorization: Bearer SA-creator
X-Redwood-Project-Hint: proj-42
{ "ttl": 3600, "attribution": "target" }
```

irene: +1. I'll include those header names in telemetry schema and log examples.

noah-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-1350 "delegated-ephemeral-tokens: routing, telemetry, and UX" and linked this thread.

maria: action items: @sam - write routing + quota RFC (include soft/hard quota semantics), @irene - telemetry schema + dashboard mocks, @leo - modal UX + console copy + revoke flow. target: RFC + mocks in two weeks.

sam: will start RFC tomorrow, calling out edgecases (async webhooks, queued workers).

irene: mock dashboards ETA 3 business days.

maria: thanks all. keep the canary small and coordinate with support for any billing questions. :eyes:
